appraisal_events.evidence: Il vint à nous la main tendue : « Connaissez-vous, monsieur le liseur, me demanda-t-il... Lisez-le, mon enfant »
appraisal_events.explanation: The next day Legrandin approaches warmly and singles out the narrator personally, addressing him with an affectionate epithet and giving him direct literary counsel, marking him as a favored young interlocutor.

status_effects.explanation: Legrandin's personal, warm attention locally includes the narrator in his favor, distinct from and following the earlier coolness shown toward the father.
